paragraphs_html: I am a Human Factors researcher and Ph.D. student in Industrial and Operations Engineering at the {{umich_blue}}, where I work as a Graduate Research Assistant in the {{ihub_blue}} and am advised by Dr. Manhua Wang.
research_interests_html: Human behavior modeling grounded in human factors theories and frameworks.
Risk perception, situation awareness, and decision-making during human-machine interaction.
Behavioral and multimodal datasets used to develop theory-based quantitative models for actionable feedback and system interventions in automated driving and intelligent mobility.
about.education_html: I hold an M.S. in Human Factors and Ergonomics from {{sjsu_plain}}, where I previously conducted research at the {{batlab_blue}} and was advised by Dr. Gaojian Huang.
